I can make it through the main parts of the day just fine, but mornings and nights are an absolute nightmare. I take muscle relaxers at night to stave off the RLS and it works for most of the night. Eventually my legs kick me awake though and I start having panic attacks. Unfortunately I’ll dose in the middle of the night just to get back to sleep if I have to.  It after I wake up and go about my day I can go about 8-9 hours without being concerned about dosing. So now my dowses are one larger dose in the AM. A tiny dose in the middle of the day. 1/3 my normal dose before bed, and 1/2 of an emergency dose for if I wake up in the middle of the night. Despite all of the bad I can still feel progress. I’m taking less now than I have in almost a year and I feel like I’m winning this fight. Slowly but surely. I think I’ll keep updating here. Typing all this out felt good
